fusions.name: Heavy Swell
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Slowed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Seabed Drop
fusions.desc: Brings the weight of the reef down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Heaving Tide
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds. While it lasts, a mass of reef fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathering Mass
fusions.desc: When you strike an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
